header: Plays Pilotwings 64 for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs: the launcher, Load ROM once the shader list Chrome
builds behind it is done (a click while it builds is lost, and the game never starts; Firefox builds none there, and
its line saying so is the one waited for), the title, then tests started as a player starts them, through the menus
(tools/shader_survey.js's go(), which presses Start and A and writes the vehicle and class at the pilot select, a
need that fails the run unless that vehicle and class are flying), each flown 30 s: the hang glider's first Beginner
test and the skydive's first B test (Ever-Frost Island), each ended through its results by land(), then the
gyrocopter's first B test (Little States). The gyrocopter comes last: its test runs on its own clock, which land()'s
presses of A don't end, and the cannonball's goes on to its next target. Each vehicle is flown by holding keys for so
many ms of the browser's time.
